de.name: German
de.marketNotes: Germany, Austria, Switzerland. Use standard formal 'Sie' register throughout — this is a productivity tool for knowledge workers and researchers. Strongly emphasize data sovereignty, local-first processing, and EU/German hosting ('nothing leaves your machine' / Ollama support). Keep product terms (e.g. 'Digest', 'LocalSend', 'Kindle', 'Markdown') in their standard technical forms.

fr.name: French
fr.marketNotes: France + francophone Europe/Canada. Use polite 'vous' register throughout. Emphasize GDPR compliance, local on-device LLM execution, and EU data privacy. Keep technical terms ('on-device', 'LocalSend', 'Kindle') natural; keep EUR pricing as-is.

es.name: Spanish
es.marketNotes: Neutral, pan-regional Spanish (avoid slang exclusive to Spain or Argentina). Use polite modern SaaS address ('tú' for web copy/guides, standard clear imperatives for UI). Emphasize local offline processing with Ollama and zero-data-leakage architecture. Keep EUR pricing neutral without qualifying it as cheap or expensive.

zh.name: Chinese (Simplified)
zh.marketNotes: Simplified Chinese (targeting Singapore, Malaysia, and global diaspora tech workers). Professional, modern developer/SaaS tone. Note that Chrome Web Store distribution requires external access, so avoid 'works seamlessly everywhere' mainland-specific claims. Emphasize on-device AI privacy and self-hosting/Ollama support. Keep key tech terms ('Ollama', 'LocalSend', 'Kindle', 'Markdown', 'API key') in English.

zh-TW.name: Chinese (Traditional)
zh-TW.marketNotes: Taiwan and Hong Kong knowledge workers, researchers, and developers. Use Traditional Chinese characters (繁體中文) with natural Taiwan/HK tech phrasing (e.g., use 隱私, 伺服器 for server, 本地/本機 for local). Since Chrome Web Store access is unrestricted in both markets, focus copy on productivity workflows, privacy, and frictionless browser integration. Keep terms like 'Ollama', 'LocalSend', 'Kindle', 'Markdown', and 'API Key' in English.

ja.name: Japanese
ja.marketNotes: Standard polite business register (丁寧語 - Desu/Masu form). Avoid stiff archaic honorifics (Kenjougo). Use standard Katakana for common developer/tech concepts (e.g., ダイジェスト for Digest, オンデバイス for on-device, ローカル for local). Emphasize privacy, zero server storage, and lightweight productivity.

ko.name: Korean
ko.marketNotes: Standard polite modern SaaS tone (해요체 / Haeyo-che for web pages and blog posts, clear concise 명사형 / verb stems for buttons/UI). Keep technical ecosystem terms ('Ollama', 'Kindle', 'LocalSend', 'Markdown') in English or widely accepted loanword forms. Highlight local processing speed and privacy.

pt.name: Portuguese (Brazil)
pt.marketNotes: Standard Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) tech register (using 'você' and natural gerunds, e.g., 'processando no dispositivo'). Avoid trying to force a hybrid PT-PT/PT-BR neutral style. Emphasize the free, offline, local-model (Ollama) capability and lack of recurring API subscription costs.

hi.name: Hindi
hi.marketNotes: Modern conversational tech register (Hinglish-friendly) for Indian tech professionals and developers. Keep all core interface nouns, shortcuts, tool names, and commands in English/Latin script (e.g., 'Digest', 'Kindle', 'LocalSend', 'Ollama', 'on-device', 'API key'). Highlight offline local LLM execution and zero recurring cost prominently.

vi.name: Vietnamese
vi.marketNotes: Professional, modern tech tone. Use standard neutral tech vocabulary for UI actions. Emphasize speed, local offline AI processing, Kindle export, and privacy.

nl.name: Dutch
nl.marketNotes: Netherlands and Belgium (Flanders). Informal-but-professional "je/jij" for web copy, clear imperatives in UI. Emphasize privacy, GDPR, local processing with Ollama, no tracking.

it.name: Italian
it.marketNotes: Italy and Italian-speaking Switzerland. Polite but modern "tu" for web copy (as common in SaaS), clear imperatives in UI. Emphasize GDPR privacy, on-device processing and Ollama.

ru.name: Russian
ru.marketNotes: Russian-speaking users worldwide. Neutral professional tone, "вы" register. Emphasize privacy, local models (Ollama) and bring-your-own-key. Keep tech terms (Ollama, Kindle, LocalSend, Markdown, API key) in Latin script.

uk.name: Ukrainian
uk.marketNotes: Ukraine. Natural modern Ukrainian (not translated through Russian), "ви" register. Emphasize privacy, local on-device models (Ollama) and bring-your-own-key. Keep tech terms (Ollama, Kindle, LocalSend, Markdown, API key) in Latin script.

tr.name: Turkish
tr.marketNotes: Turkey. Polite modern "siz" register for web copy, concise UI verbs. Emphasize privacy, local processing with Ollama, bring-your-own-key. Keep tech terms in English.

id.name: Indonesian
id.marketNotes: Indonesia. Standard modern Indonesian, neutral-friendly "Anda" register, concise UI verbs. Emphasize free to start, local/offline AI with Ollama and privacy. Keep tech terms in English.

pl.name: Polish
pl.marketNotes: Poland. Professional modern register ("Ty" capitalised is not needed; use "możesz" style or impersonal forms). Emphasize GDPR privacy, local processing with Ollama, bring-your-own-key.

th.name: Thai
th.marketNotes: Thailand. Polite modern tech tone using neutral particles (ครับ/ค่ะ avoided; use impersonal phrasing). Keep tech terms (Ollama, Kindle, LocalSend, Markdown, API key) in English. Emphasize local/offline AI, privacy and speed.

ar.name: Arabic
ar.marketNotes: Modern Standard Arabic (neutral, readable across regions), right-to-left. Professional modern tech tone. Keep tech terms (Ollama, Kindle, LocalSend, Markdown, API key) in Latin script and keep numerals and URLs unchanged. Emphasize privacy, local on-device AI and bring-your-own-key.

sv.name: Swedish
sv.marketNotes: Sweden (and Swedish-speaking Finland). Informal modern "du" register, plain and concise like Swedish SaaS copy. Emphasize privacy, GDPR, local processing with Ollama and bring-your-own-key. Keep tech terms (Ollama, Kindle, LocalSend, Markdown, API key) in English.

da.name: Danish
da.marketNotes: Denmark. Informal modern "du" register, plain and concise. Emphasize privacy, GDPR, local processing with Ollama and bring-your-own-key. Keep tech terms (Ollama, Kindle, LocalSend, Markdown, API key) in English.

no.name: Norwegian (Bokmål)
no.marketNotes: Norway. Norwegian Bokmål, informal modern "du" register, plain and concise. Emphasize privacy, local processing with Ollama and bring-your-own-key. Keep tech terms (Ollama, Kindle, LocalSend, Markdown, API key) in English.

fi.name: Finnish
fi.marketNotes: Finland. Natural modern Finnish, informal "sinä" implied, concise UI verbs (avoid stiff literal translations of English). Emphasize privacy, GDPR, local processing with Ollama and bring-your-own-key. Keep tech terms (Ollama, Kindle, LocalSend, Markdown, API key) in English.
